verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's GitHub Action explicitly provides automated PR code review with contextual feedback and suggestions (gemini-cli-gh-10), backed by an on-demand @gemini-cli mention feature for PRs/issues (gemini-cli-gh-12/21) and community corroboration that Gemini's code review caught bugs reviewers missed (gemini-cli-comm-20). missing for 10: independent hands-on testing specifically of the PR-review GitHub Action workflow (most community evidence concerns the CLI agent itself, not the review action) and detail on review depth/configurability.
